title: Business Development Executive
description:

A highly respected Commercial Insurer in Colchester (with an outstanding reputation in the market) is looking to recruit a Business Development Executive to join their growth-focused team.

- Proactively generating new business opportunities with local companies
- Targeting and engaging businesses to uncover Insurance needs
- Building a consistent pipeline through outbound calls, referrals, introductions and networking
- Booking and attending client meetings (phone, video and face-to-face) to complete fact-finds and understand risk
- Helping prepare and deliver professional proposals and presentations

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be driven by consistent customer engagement, proactive account management and commercial performance.

You will be expected to maintain structured customer contact and achieve agreed activity and sales targets. Typical activity levels will include 50-70 customer conversations per day alongside ownership of a monthly account contact programme.

Performance will be measured through sales revenue, gross profit growth, account development, customer retention, new account acquisition and agreed activity targets.

About You:

To be successful, you will need:
- Previous experience in B2 B sales, account management, business development, internal sales or telesales.
- Experience managing and developing customer accounts.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Confidence engaging customers and influencing purchasing decisions.
- A professional telephone manner and excellent verbal communication.
- Commercial awareness and a results-focused approach.
- Strong organisational, planning and time-management skills.
- Experience using CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
- A proactive, resilient and persistent approach to sales.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and work to targets.
- A practical, customer-focused approach to problem solving.

Experience within plumbing, heating, construction products, merchanting or distribution would be advantageous.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, consistently delivers on commitments and maintains high professional standards. Most importantly, you will share our commitment to outstanding customer service through product knowledge, responsiveness, reliability and a customer-first mindset.

What We Offer:
- Established customer portfolio to manage and develop.
- Clear and achievable sales targets.
- Structured training and ongoing professional development.
- In-house certifications and skills development opportunities.
- Supportive environment where ideas, accountability and continuous improvement are valued.
- Genuine long-term career progression opportunities.
- Monday-Friday working hours with no weekend work.
- Opportunity to join a growing family-run business.
